name: Instant Pot Irish Guinness Stew
description: A rich and hearty Irish stew made with stewing beef, streaky bacon, carrots, onions, and Guinness in an Instant Pot Rio pressure cooker.
recipeIngredient: 600 g stewing steak, cut into large chunks

recipeInstructions.name: Brown the bacon
recipeInstructions.text: Set the Instant Pot to Sauté mode. Add the chopped streaky bacon and cook until browned and releasing fat, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Brown the beef
recipeInstructions.text: Add vegetable oil if needed. Toss the beef with flour, salt, and pepper. Brown the beef in batches for 2-3 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the vegetables
recipeInstructions.text: Add onions and carrots to the pot and sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

recipeInstructions.name: Deglaze the pot
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in the Guinness and scrape the bottom of the pot thoroughly to release any browned bits.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine ingredients
recipeInstructions.text: Return the beef and bacon to the pot. Add beef stock, tomato purée, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and bay leaves. Stir well.

recipeInstructions.name: Pressure cook
recipeInstructions.text: Seal the lid and set the Instant Pot to Pressure Cook (High) for 35 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Release pressure
recipeInstructions.text: Allow a natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then carefully quick release any remaining pressure.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Remove bay leaves. Taste and adjust seasoning. If a thicker stew is desired, use Sauté mode for a few minutes to reduce further. Garnish with parsley before serving.
